question: Estimate how many Indians may adopt AI healthcare assistants (apps that triage / answer health queries) in 5 years.
idealClarificationQuestions: AI healthcare assistant: app that lets you describe symptoms and get LLM-driven guidance, prescription support? Yes.
Active monthly users 5 years out (2031)? Yes.
Includes both standalone (Practo AI, Tata Health AI) and embedded (insurance app AI bots)? Yes.
All of India or urban only? Pan-India urban + Tier 2 (rural lags).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Top-down: addressable population (smartphone, internet, healthcare-conscious) × adoption curve over 5 years.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, healthcare-conscious (urban + Tier 2 + middle class+): ~35% = 140M as TAM.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: 40-50M monthly active users of AI healthcare assistants in India by 2031.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, comfortable using AI/chat for sensitive topics
benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~40% = 400M (assumes ChatGPT-style adoption normalizes AI by then).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, healthcare-conscious (urban + Tier 2 + middle class+)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: 40-50M monthly active users of AI healthcare assistants in India by 2031.

calculationFlow: Of these, comfortable using AI/chat for sensitive topics: ~40% = 400M (assumes ChatGPT-style adoption normalizes AI by then).
